No real Provider CLI is started and no Provider usage is consumed by this task; .agents/v2/provider-preflight/ is still empty when it ends.

constraints: Do not start any Provider CLI. This task consumes zero Provider usage; there is no circumstance in which it needs to.

Do not remove, reorder or shorten external_dependencies.providers in any capability. Promoting a capability by deleting codex or opencode from its declaration is a substantive weakening of the contract and is forbidden; three Provider live remains V2-028's work in M6.

Do not edit contracts/release-contract/foundation.json or internal/release/**. internal/release/release.go decodes foundation.json with DisallowUnknownFields and is concurrently held by another task; if you conclude the declaration must live in foundation.json, stop and escalate rather than editing either file.
Do not weaken docs/architecture/roadmap.md M6's completion conditions, in particular '共通adapter変更を3 Providerすべてで実証する'.

Another agent is concurrently editing internal/release/**, docs/preview/**, docs/stable/**, docs/operations/release-local.md and .agents/v2/evidence/**. Touch none of them beyond the single new evidence file and the single appended index entry.
Append exactly one entry to .agents/v2/evidence/index.json. Do not reformat, reorder or rewrite the file; edit it as an insertion so no other entry's bytes change.
Do not create, edit or delete anything under .agents/v2/packets/. The four packets for V2-047 and V2-017 are inputs to this task, not outputs.

Do not add a keyword to any schema that internal/contracts/validator.go does not implement. maxItems, oneOf, anyOf, allOf, if/then/else, dependentRequired and uniqueItems are silently ignored by the validator, so a schema using them would be documentation pretending to be a gate.
Do not author an approval block. approver, approved_at and approval_reference for the real record are supplied by the human owner to V2-017.

Do not add a .gitleaks.toml allowlist speculatively. Measure with make secrets first, and if you add one, use condition = "AND", scope it to a path prefix and an anchored value shape, and commit a positive control proving a real secret of a neighbouring shape is still reported.
Do not write a passed status for a check you did not actually run. If an acceptance criterion cannot be satisfied, stop and escalate with the observed output rather than adjusting the criterion.
Read the component evidence key only at the final tree where make check (including format) is green, after git add and commit.
Commit as checkpoints; do not push. The coordinator pushes, one checkpoint at a time.
